content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   Seekers Spirits, located in Siem Reap, [Cambodia](/destinations/cambodia/), produces award-winning dry gins utilizing local botanicals such as Kampot pepper, local citrus, and pandan, reflecting the biodiversity of the Mekong region.
> *   The 2-hour distillery experience includes a technical tour of copper stills, an explanation of botanical sourcing, a guided tasting flight of Mekong Dry Gin and liqueurs paired with local chocolates, and a bespoke gin cocktail crafting session.
> *   Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) offers priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for this year-round available experience, which is best paired with a late afternoon transition before dinner.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Discover the unexpected rise of premium craft distillation in Cambodia. Explore the botanical complexity of Seekers Spirits, drawing on the immense biodiversity of the Mekong region.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Seekers Spirits captured the global craft gin movement and anchored it securely in Southeast Asia. Recognizing the incredible array of local botanicals—from Kampot pepper to local citrus and pandan—they produce award-winning dry gins that taste distinctly of the region.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
You will be transferred to the distillery and tasting room. The experience begins with a technical tour of the copper stills and an explanation of the complex local botanical sourcing across Cambodia. 

The highlight is a guided tasting flight, where an expert mixologist walks you through the flavor profiles of their Mekong Dry Gin and flavored liqueurs, paired perfectly with artisan local chocolates. The afternoon concludes with you crafting your own bespoke gin cocktail.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Modern, Artisanal, Relaxed |
| **Duration** | 2 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | Low |
| **Best Paired With** | A late afternoon transition before heading to dinner. |

## The Ideal 19th-Hole Botanical Tasting After Angkor Golf Resort
Located in Siem Reap’s creative Kandal and Kruos corridor—less than 12 minutes from the 18th green of [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) and 20 minutes from [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/)—**Seekers Independent Spirits** is Cambodia’s premier post-round afternoon distillery experience. When a fourball wraps up a morning round on Sir Nick Faldo’s immaculate Paspalum fairways and returns to [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/), [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), or [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), a 4:00 PM private distillery tour bridges the golden-hour gap between poolside recovery and evening fine dining.

Because the two-hour session is seated inside an air-conditioned copper-still room and lush botanical garden bar, it requires zero physical strain while immersing your group in the terroir of the Mekong basin.

## Copper-Still Technical Briefing & Bespoke Flight Curation
* **Eleven-Botanical Mekong Terroir:** Your distillery host breaks down how red and black Kampot pepper, battambang oranges, Khmer basil, pandan leaf, galangal, and jasmine rice spirits are vapor-infused inside custom copper pot stills to create Seekers Mekong Dry Gin.
* **Guided Flight & Artisanal Chocolate Pairing:** Guests sample neat expressions of Mekong Dry Gin, Coffee Liqueur, and limited-edition barrel-aged releases paired with single-origin Cambodian dark chocolates and fresh river citrus.
* **Seamless Dinner Transition:** Following your final bespoke G&T in the garden courtyard, your standby AGS luxury MPV transfers your party five minutes across town to [Cuisine Wat Damnak](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-cuisine-wat-damnak/) or [Miss Wong Cocktail Bar](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-nightlife-miss-wong-cocktail-bar/).

## Pairing Seekers Spirits With Siem Reap’s Championship Fairways & Five-Star Resorts
For groups traveling on [The Khmer Temple Trail](/tours/the-khmer-temple-trail/) or [Cambodia Angkor Odyssey](/tours/cambodia-angkor-odyssey/), a late-afternoon botanical gin flight at Seekers Spirits fits naturally after a morning round at [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/), [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/), or [Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club](/courses/cambodia/siem-reap-booyoung/). Guests staying at [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/), [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), or [Jaya House River Park](/accommodations/cambodia/jaya-house-river-park/) can also request custom-engraved Seekers Mekong Dry Gin bottles delivered directly to their suite or private pool villa as commemorative tournament prizes for longest drive and nearest-the-pin winners.

faqs.q: How close is Seekers Spirits Distillery to Angkor Golf Resort and Siem Reap's luxury hotels?
faqs.a: Seekers Spirits sits roughly 10 to 12 minutes by private SUV from Angkor Golf Resort, Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor, Amansara, and Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang, making it an effortless late-afternoon 19th-hole stop in Siem Reap.

faqs.q: What is included in a private Seekers Spirits gin tasting for golf groups?
faqs.a: The 2-hour private session includes a welcome Mekong Dry Gin & Tonic, a technical walkthrough of the copper stills and botanical garden, a guided flight of four craft spirits paired with Cambodian artisanal chocolate, and a signature cocktail.

faqs.q: Can we buy limited-edition bottles at Seekers Spirits in Siem Reap for our flight home?
faqs.a: Yes. Distillery-exclusive small-batch gins and liqueurs are available in travel-safe padded packaging that fits securely inside hard-shell luggage or golf travel covers within standard duty-free liquid limits.
